resources.string: Open-ended official families are available in Raw mode: Pokémon name/nickname/Dex number and type, +evolution family, CP/HP/distance/age/year min/max/ranges, @move, @type, @1/@2/@3 move type, and #tag.

Official parameterized examples: cp-1500 · hp100- · age0-7 · year2026 · +Pikachu · @shadow ball · @3ghost · #tag. Use & for multiple criteria, ! for NOT, and , : ; for multiple searches. PokeQuery intentionally blocks | to keep generated strings canonical.
